segments.ja388:1.1: Navachannake [navachandake (sī. pī.), navacchaddake (syā.)] dāni [doṇi (ka.), dānaṃ, dāne (katthaci)] diyyati, puṇṇāyaṃ doṇi suvāminī ṭhitā;
segments.ja388:1.3: Bahuke jane pāsapāṇike, no ca kho me paṭibhāti bhuñjituṃ.
segments.ja388:2.1: Tasasi bhamasi leṇamicchasi, attāṇosi kuhiṃ gamissasi;
segments.ja388:2.3: Appossukko bhuñja tuṇḍila, maṃsatthāya hi positāmhase [posiyāmase (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja388:3.1: Ogaha rahadaṃ akaddamaṃ, sabbaṃ sedamalaṃ pavāhaya;
segments.ja388:3.3: Gaṇhāhi navaṃ vilepanaṃ, yassa gandho na kadāci chijjati.
segments.ja388:4.1: Katamo rahado akaddamo, kiṃsu sedamalanti vuccati;
segments.ja388:4.3: Katamañca navaṃ vilepanaṃ, yassa gandho na kadāci chijjati.
segments.ja388:5.1: Dhammo rahado akaddamo, pāpaṃ sedamalanti vuccati;
segments.ja388:5.3: Sīlañca navaṃ vilepanaṃ, tassa gandho na kadāci chijjati.
segments.ja388:6.1: Nandanti sarīraghātino, na ca nandanti sarīradhārino;
segments.ja388:6.3: Puṇṇāya ca puṇṇamāsiyā, ramamānāva jahanti jīvitanti.
